architecture.shock_detection: hysteretic max of causal task-reference jump and one-step innovation-rate score
architecture.bumpless_offset_engagement: rate-limited CART-to-robust engagement state; no abrupt offset switch
architecture.final_input_coordination: single physical command blends CART's constrained command and immutable Full-LQR stabilizer before a common limiter
architecture.slew_headroom: optional shock-dependent command amplitude and per-update reserve within, never beyond, frozen authority
architecture.conflict_index: coordinate-free opposition cosine between controllable innovation-equivalent acceleration and measured desired tip displacement
architecture.cancellation_index: opposition and co-activation of task-LQR backbone and CART QP correction

stage_b.selection_rule: all frozen hard gates, then worst directional P90, strong mean, overall mean, normal mean, acquisition, effort, runtime, candidate id

stage_c.candidate_source: top eight Stage-B parameter sets; no new configuration
stage_c.confirmation_rule: all frozen gates must pass again

rationale: Broadly vary causal shock duration/blend, geometric conflict/cancellation coordination, and conservative authority reserve; include both V4 CART Pareto anchors without retuning either as V4.
failure_rule: If no Stage-C confirmed pass, close V5_SELF_NO_DEVELOPMENT_QUALIFICATION; do not run Paper or Holdout.
